It filters for financial reports dated December 31, 2025, and searches for the Total Assets concept either by the numeric tag 'TotalAssets' or by the human-readable tlabel containing 'Total Assets'. The coreg column identifies the reporting entity, which would allow filtering for Tesla specifically if the coreg value is known.
sql_attempts: SELECT n.coreg, n.tag, n.ddate, n.value, t.tlabel FROM sec.public.num AS n JOIN sec.public.tag AS t ON n.tag = t.tag WHERE n.ddate = '2025-12-31' AND (n.tag = 'TotalAssets' OR t.tlabel ILIKE '%Total Assets%') ORDER BY n.coreg;

sql: SELECT pre.plabel, pre.tag, num.coreg, num.ddate, num.qtrs, num.value AS net_income_value, num.uom, num.segments FROM sec.public.pre AS pre JOIN sec.public.num AS num ON pre.adsh = num.adsh WHERE pre.tag = 'NetIncomeLoss' AND num.coreg = '0001213900-26-005908' AND num.qtrs = 4 AND num.ddate BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-12-31' ORDER BY num.ddate DESC LIMIT 1;

sql: SELECT n.value AS revenue FROM sec.public.num AS n JOIN sec.public.sub AS s ON s.adsh = n.adsh WHERE s.name = 'JPMORGAN CHASE & CO' AND s.form = '10-K' AND s.period = '2025-12-31' AND n.tag IN ('Revenues','RevenueFromContractWithCustomerExcludingAssessedTax','RevenuesNetOfInterestExpense') AND n.ddate = s.period AND n.qtrs = 4 AND n.segments IS NULL AND n.coreg IS NULL AND n.uom = 'USD' ORDER BY CASE n.tag WHEN 'Revenues' THEN 1 WHEN 'RevenueFromContractWithCustomerExcludingAssessedTax' THEN 2 ELSE 3 END LIMIT 1;
answer: This query retrieves JPMorgan Chase's total revenue for the fiscal year ended December 31, 2025, by joining the sec.public.num and sec.public.sub tables on the accession number (adsh). It filters for the company name 'JPMORGAN CHASE & CO', the 10-K form, the period end date of 2025-12-31, quarterly coverage of 4 (full fiscal year), consolidated amounts (segments and coreg both NULL), and USD unit of measure. The tag priority ordering ensures the primary 'Revenues' line item is selected first, and LIMIT 1 returns the single most relevant revenue figure from the filing.

sql_attempts: SELECT pre.plabel, num.value AS net_income FROM sec.public.pre AS pre JOIN sec.public.sub AS sub ON pre.adsh = sub.adsh JOIN sec.public.tag AS tag ON pre.tag = tag.tag JOIN sec.public.num AS num ON tag.tag = num.tag WHERE sub.name ILIKE '%WALMART%' AND sub.fy = 2026 AND num.ddate = '2026-01-31' AND num.qtrs = 4 AND pre.plabel ILIKE '%Net income%' AND num.uom = 'USD';

sql: SELECT n.value AS revenue FROM sec.public.num AS n JOIN sec.public.sub AS s ON s.adsh = n.adsh JOIN sec.public.tag AS t ON n.tag = t.tag JOIN sec.public.pre AS p ON t.tag = p.tag WHERE s.name ILIKE '%AMAZON%' AND s.form = '10-K' AND s.period = '2025-12-31' AND n.qtrs = 4 AND n.segments IS NULL AND n.coreg IS NULL AND n.uom = 'USD' AND n.ddate = s.period AND n.tag IN ('Revenues','RevenueFromContractWithCustomerExcludingAssessedTax','RevenuesNetOfInterestExpense') ORDER BY CASE n.tag WHEN 'Revenues' THEN 1 WHEN 'RevenueFromContractWithCustomerExcludingAssessedTax' THEN 2 ELSE 3 END LIMIT 1
answer: This query retrieves Amazon's total revenue for the fiscal year ended December 31, 2025, from its 10-K filing. It joins the num, sub, tag, and pre tables to anchor the filing and resolve the revenue tag. The name filter uses ILIKE '%AMAZON%' to match the filer name stored in upper case. The tag is filtered by the priority order Revenues > RevenueFromContractWithCustomerExcludingAssessedTax > RevenuesNetOfInterestExpense, with qtrs=4, consolidated (segments and coreg NULL), and the period end date aligned via ddate = s.period. The result is limited to the top-ranked revenue tag.

sql: SELECT n.value AS net_income FROM sec.public.num AS n JOIN sec.public.sub AS s ON s.adsh = n.adsh JOIN sec.public.pre AS p ON p.adsh = s.adsh JOIN sec.public.tag AS t ON t.tag = n.tag WHERE s.name = 'WALMART INC' AND s.form = '10-K' AND s.period = '2026-01-31' AND n.tag IN ('NetIncomeLoss','NetIncomeLossAvailableToCommonStockholdersBasic') AND n.ddate = s.period AND n.qtrs = 4 AND n.segments IS NULL AND n.coreg IS NULL AND n.uom = 'USD' ORDER BY CASE n.tag WHEN 'NetIncomeLoss' THEN 1 ELSE 2 END LIMIT 1
answer: This query retrieves Walmart's net income for the fiscal year ended January 31, 2026, by joining the XBRL fact table (num) with the subsidiary filing metadata (sub) and the reporting tag bridge (pre, tag). It filters for the company 'WALMART INC' on form 10-K with fiscal year end period 2026-01-31, selects the net income metric tag (NetIncomeLoss or NetIncomeLossAvailableToCommonStockholdersBasic), ensures the value covers a full fiscal year (qtrs=4), is consolidated (segments IS NULL, coreg IS NULL), and is reported in USD. The result is limited to the first matching row ordered by tag priority.
